header.name: Artificial Intelligence
header.description: This is an introductory course in Artificial Intelligence. This course introduces the students to various search techniques, knowledge representation, reasoning under uncertainty and learning.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to apply basic search techniques for problem solving.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to explain how to represent knowledge required for problem solving and automated planning.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to quantify uncertainty, explain probabilistic reasoning and decision making.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to utilize AI for application in real world.

lecture_topics: Problem solving: Adversarial search and games
Knowledge, reasoning and planning: Knowledge representation
Knowledge, reasoning and planning: Automated planning
Uncertain knowledge and reasoning: Probabilistic reasoning (Bayesian Network, Hidden Markov Models/ Causality)
Uncertain knowledge and reasoning: Decision making

resources.title: Artificial Intelligence: A modern approach, 4th edition -- Stuart Russell and Peter Norvig
A First course on Artificial Intelligence – Deepak Khemani, McGraw Hill India
Artificial Intelligence: A New Synthesis -- Nils J. Nilsson, Morgan Kaufmann Publishers
